summary: Frontend-only regression after i18n duplicate 'read_story' key removal and ReaderEnding onHome prop cleanup. All four acceptance criteria verified on web preview (mobile 430x900, English).

verification_results.home_renders_and_card_opens_reader: PASS - Home (/discover) rendered with story cards; tapping a non-lesson card opened the reader (no blank screen / crash).
verification_results.i18n_aria_label_check: PASS - Found 2 non-lesson story-card open overlays; both aria-labels start with 'Read the story:' (e.g. 'Read the story: Su Venere un giorno dura più di un anno', 'Read the story: Perché il pop-corn scoppia'). No generic 'Read:' label observed. Confirms duplicate i18n 'read_story' key is gone.
verification_results.final_screen_regression: PASS - At /deep-dive/sky-blue-sunset-orange?start=1 reached final screen. reader-header-logo present, reader-back present, ending-read-btn visible, next-story visible. Clicking next-story navigated to /deep-dive/v9-the-red-sky-in-munch-s-scream-was-real-a-volcano-behind-... Clicking ending-read-btn (Discover) also navigated away to a different story URL. Both controls work after onHome prop removal.
verification_results.console_errors: PASS - 0 red console/page errors captured during the full flow (home -> open story -> deep-dive -> end -> next, and -> discover).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest flow on web preview: load base URL, wait ~8s for Metro bundle, click 'Continue as guest', pick 1+ categories (e.g. Science/Space/Nature), click 'Start discovering' to reach /discover. Story card open overlays are selectable via data-testid matching ^home-story-.*-open$ with aria-label attribute. Deep-dive final screen reliably reached in ~1-2 wheel scrolls on /deep-dive/sky-blue-sunset-orange?start=1 (viewport 430x900).
